segments: A close-up of water being squeezes from a mop fades in. The view zooms out to reveal a young man holding the mop. He has earbuds in and stands in the middle of an empty hallway.
He starts to mop the floor, and the title card "Mop" appears as he mops to the right, then disappears as he mops to the left. He continues mopping.
He leaves his mop against a wall, walks away, and crouches down.
A man in a suit walks down the hall. The young man's back is turned. Then, the man in the suit slips with a loud thud.
The young man slowly removes his earbuds. He stands up slowly, holding a caution sign, and turns toward the man.
The young man sees the man lying unmoving on the ground. The young man groans.
The young man uses the handle of the mop to poke the man. He's not responsive.
The young man approaches the man and starts dragging him down the hall with a great deal of struggle.
The young man presses the elevator button and drags the man in with him. Then, the young man presses a button and the elevator doors close. The screen fades to black.
